summary: Borr Drilling Ltd (BORR), via subsidiary Borr IHC Limited, announced an increase in its cash tender offer for any and all of its outstanding 10.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2030, originally capped at $447.3M. As of May 27, 2026, $877.1M original principal (≈$770.7M after amortization) is outstanding. The amended financing condition requires completion of a new notes offering of at least $2,035M. Citigroup is dealer manager; Global Bondholder Services is information/tender agent. No redemption notice is given; no recommendation made. To watch: whether the new notes offering is completed on satisfactory terms, enabling full tender settlement and liability management.
